scientific_limitations: The exact sign threshold is for the coefficient of \(t^{n-4}\), not for simultaneous positivity of every Ehrhart coefficient. The full non-positivity monotonicity conjecture is not settled. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: A unique sharp Ehrhart coefficient threshold for one-step lecture-hall simplices
